bundle.shortDescription: Multi-agent terminal for AI coding workflows over SSH
bundle.longDescription: YMUX is a multi-agent desktop terminal optimized for AI coding workflows over SSH, inspired by cmux. Runs natively on Windows and macOS. Ships a tunnel-aware CLI on remote Linux servers so AI agents can pipe permission requests and lifecycle events back to the desktop UI for explicit Allow/Deny decisions.
